newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian boy picks up gun, fires at Israelis.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian boy picks up gun, fires at Israelis.

text.p: A Palestinian boy briefly joined the Gaza Strip gunbattles on Thursday, picking up the rifle of a wounded Palestinian policeman and firing at Israeli soldiers, witnesses said.
They said the policeman dropped the rifle after being shot in the neck.
The boy, who looked to be about 12 to 14 years old, then took it from the ground and fired at Israeli troops until Palestinian policemen persuaded him to hand over the weapon, witnesses said.

Palestinian health officials said at least nine Palestinians have been killed in two days of clashes with soldiers over Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's decision to open a tunnel near an Islamic holy site in Jerusalem.

Netanyahu, who came to power 100 days ago on a promise to bolster Israeli security, decided to cut short a visit to Europe on Thursday because of the violence in the West Bank, the Gaza Strip and Jerusalem.
